answer: How do you prevent a farm of saffron signals leaking into your cipher? Every identity’s proof locks to a one tweak of Planck-scale permuted light, tuned to the exact 486nm saffron line; the filter only opens when a real iris passes 7 femtoseconds later. Each sybil rerun costs one femtosecond of glass soak lost to thermal blooming—no bulk silica can batch that exact spectral residue.
